member.remarks: The attributes are splatted after the style attribute generated by the component, therefore passing style here replaces the / declarations. An id passed here takes precedence over (and is used for the JavaScript interop as well).

member.name: P:Havit.Blazor.Components.Web.ECharts.HxEChart.ChartIdEffective
member.summary: The id the container is actually rendered with (and therefore the one the JavaScript interop has to use). An id coming from wins, as it is splatted after the id attribute generated by the component.
member.remarks: The keys are matched case-insensitively on purpose: Blazor eliminates the duplicate id attribute case-insensitively, so an Id/ID key wins in the rendered markup just like a lowercase id does. We cannot rely on the dictionary comparer here - the framework builds the splatted dictionary with , but a consumer passing explicitly may well use a case-sensitive one.
